description: Library Maintenance's Dashboard page delivered as the kit's AdminScript pattern, as admin at 1366 px. The first open from the Dashboard drawer renders the tabs and the data at once, with no navigation away and back; the LibraryMaintenanceJs stub's dynamic import() of /LibraryMaintenance/AdminScript is one request per document; an extra &tab= parameter on #/configurationpage reaches mount's params; history.replaceState on that route doesn't reload the page, a hash change does (a new view, the module not fetched again); leaving and coming back renders again; a reload straight into the page renders. Read-only: it changes nothing on the server.
